title: Musica Medievale 🏹
author: Musica Medievale 🏹
description:
The best, and probably only, YouTube channel about Medieval Music.

Monetization on this channel is disabled to offer the highest possible listening quality. Every ads are by YouTube and the proceeds go directly to the artists or labels. The purpose of the channel is only to spread quality medieval music accompanied by videos with images taken from original sources.
